answer: Require two cross-signatures, then weight them by disagreement. When the two vouchers score the same submission differently, both lose half their influence for that epoch, so colluding pairs gain nothing and honest pairs gain a little. Map every vouch onto an atlas of prior relationships and flag any spiral where the same few keys keep backing each other. Price the result: a farm must recruit outside its own circle, which means the tide of fake identities needs real counterparts to vouch.
